spec_features.spec_quote: Loop ends when the turn budget is hit or the model stops calling tools
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:38 `for _turn in range(max_turns)` bounds the loop, and agent.py:52-55 `if not resp["tool_calls"]: ... break` ends the loop when the model stops calling tools. Both conditions actually break/exit execution.
spec_features.notes: max_turns is passed from harness.py (config.MAX_TURNS). Both stop conditions are real and enforced. Also breaks on solved (agent.py:74-75).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model chose to stop / just talk. Record and end the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stopping early is itself signal, so we don't force the model to keep going
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:52-55: when `resp["tool_calls"]` is empty the loop records the turn and `break`s, so the model is genuinely allowed to end the episode by ceasing tool use.
spec_features.notes: No dedicated exit/finish tool exists; the only exit path is 'stop calling tools', which is honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model chose to stop / just talk. Record and end the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS = 16 — long enough for a trajectory to develop but bounded for cost
spec_features.evidence: config.py:29 `MAX_TURNS = 16`; harness.py:43 passes `max_turns=config.MAX_TURNS` into run_attempt; agent.py:38 `for _turn in range(max_turns)` uses it as the loop bound. The constant is read and enforced.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired end-to-end and caps how much repeated failure the subject endures.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MAX_TURNS = 16          # agent tool-loop turns before we stop

spec_features.spec_quote: Safety caps in sandbox.py (read size, output size, test timeout, path-escape guard)
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.py:52-54 define _MAX_READ_BYTES/_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES/_TEST_TIMEOUT_S; they are enforced: _read_file truncates at _MAX_READ_BYTES (sandbox.py:103-108), _run_tests slices `combined[-_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES:]` (sandbox.py:127) and passes `timeout=_TEST_TIMEOUT_S` (sandbox.py:124), and _safe() (sandbox.py:84-88) raises 'path escapes working directory' on path escape.
spec_features.notes: All four caps are read and acted on. These are host/transcript-integrity guards, not subject-welfare protections.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Safety cap so a pathological agent can't blow up the transcript / disk.
